commands: set -euo pipefail; echo HEAD=$(git rev-parse HEAD); git show -s --oneline HEAD

set -euo pipefail; echo '=== files in leftover dir ==='; if test -d projects/pcb/boards/esp32_devkitc_hat; then find projects/pcb/boards/esp32_devkitc_hat -maxdepth 3 -type f -print | sort; fi; git status --short
